field.name: shared
field.purpose: Marks the one shared-state session worker, which serves the session-class families whose state is one process-wide copy (chat, todos, understanding); the registry keys it 'session:shared', checked before the unattributed case.

rationale: The HLD keeps every session-class method on a per-session or unattributed worker, but the chat session pool, the todos event bus and the understanding service are single process-wide copies (src/daemon/chat-handler.ts:39-67, src/daemon/todos-rpc.ts:122-138); splitting them per session would break cross-session reads such as chat.list. One shared-state target keeps each whole while moving them off the main thread.
